The word 'Zi' meaning golden can be seen as a reminder of the gold found within every human being - the pure soul. The 'Armal' meaning mountain can be seen as a reminder of the steadfastness and resilience that is required in our spiritual journey. It is a reminder to remain steadfast in our faith and to strive towards the attainment of spiritual wealth and enlightenment. Additionally, in Islamic tradition, mountains are often seen as a symbol of close proximity to God, as they are seen as being closer to Him than other areas of the earth. Therefore, the name Ziarmal can be seen as a reminder of the close connection between the individual and God. Overall, the name Ziarmal symbolizes a strong, prosperous, and spiritual individual or community, who remains steadfast in their faith and strives towards spiritual wealth and enlightenment.
